summary.headline: Florentine Codices 29–31
summary.text: Supplementary catalogue entries for Florentine codices 29–31: Esdras’s prophetic calendar, Zoroaster on the zodiacal circle and Zeus, astronomical diagrams and treatises on celestial zones, weather, earth, waters, clouds, thunder, creation, months, zodiac signs, and solar transitions, followed by notes on Andreas the philologist, Michael Apostolius, and John Rhosos.
